import {useMutation, useQuery} from '@tanstack/solid-query'
import {usePlugin} from '@conciv/plugin/experimental'
import {Acme} from './rpc.js'

export function AcmeView() {
  const ctx = usePlugin()
  const acme = () => ctx.client.rpc(Acme)
  const found = useQuery(() => acme().search.queryOptions({input: {query: 'a'}}))
  const save = useMutation(() => acme().save.mutationOptions())
  acme().events.on('saved', () => ctx.queryClient.invalidateQueries({queryKey: acme().search.key()}), {
    signal: ctx.signal,
  })
  return <button onClick={() => save.mutate({id: 'a'})}>{String(found.data)}</button>
}
